sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text: 💦 How to Use: Thoroughly wet your hair, 🫧 take a small amount of conditioning shampoo, rub to emulsify, 💆‍♀️ gently massage onto scalp and lengths for 2–3 minutes, ⏳ leave for 2 minutes, then 🚿 rinse well with plenty of water for clean, soft hair.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 

 Fermented Rice Water has been a proven elixir for hair growth for centuries. When combined with Coffee, Bhringraj, Amla, and Argan Oil. Nuskhe by Paras Ayurvedic Rice Water Conditioning Shampoo is going to blow your mind with the results it starts giving you within just Two weeks of application. For the first time in India, we proudly bring you this Ayurvedic formulation for extreme hair growth!

❉ Note:- Since everyone has a different scalp texture. Before using the entire amount, we advise you to test the product on a small area first.

Customer Care: +91-78600 00768
